title: PowerPoint deck shows immediately with 'Preparing exact slides…' indicator; navigation and notes work meanwhile
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Mock converter set to 'succeed slowly' (job stays 'processing' for ~60 s). Test deck: 5-slide 16:9 .pptx with pictures.
steps: Slides panel → Add slides → choose deck5.pptx
Immediately (before the mock job finishes) look at the Slides viewer and toolbar
Type 'note while converting' in the notes panel and let it save
expected: Within a few seconds of upload the deck tab appears and the PowerPoint viewer shows slide 1 with toolbar 'Slide 1 / 5'; a visible 'Preparing exact slides…' indicator is shown; navigation updates the counter to 'Slide 3 / 5' then 'Slide 2 / 5' and the slide changes; the typed note is kept/saved; no blocking dialog or spinner covers the viewer

title: Background conversion saves <deck>.converted.pdf in the student's folder and switches the viewer to the PDF with 'Exact slides ready'
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Mock converter set to 'succeed' (returns a valid 5-page PDF after ~3 s). Test deck: deck5.pptx.
steps: Inspect converter requests in the mock log
Wait until the mock job reports done
Look at the Slides viewer, toolbar and toasts
expected: Converter receives exactly one POST /api/convert/office-to-pdf with multipart field 'files' containing the .pptx, then GET /api/jobs/<id> polls until 'done', then one GET of outputs[0].url on the converter host; storage bucket 'lecture-slides' receives a file at '<uid>/<classId>/<uuid>.converted.pdf' (same <uid>/<classId>/<uuid> as the uploaded .pptx, contentType application/pdf, 5 pages); the viewer switches to the PDF (toolbar shows 'Page 1 / 5'); a toast/note 'Exact slides ready' appears; the 'Preparing exact slides…' indicator is gone

title: Switch to PDF keeps the slide the student is on (slide k > 1)
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Mock converter set to 'succeed slowly' (~20 s) so the student can navigate first. Test deck: deck5.pptx (each slide visibly numbered/titled).
steps: While 'Preparing exact slides…' is visible, navigate to slide 4 ('Slide 4 / 5')
Wait for the switch to the PDF
expected: After the switch the toolbar shows 'Page 4 / 5' and the displayed page is slide 4's content (same title/picture as the PowerPoint slide 4); the viewer did not jump back to page 1; 'Exact slides ready' shown, indicator gone

title: Reopening a deck that already has a PDF copy opens the PDF directly with zero converter requests
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. deck5.pptx already uploaded and its '<uuid>.converted.pdf' present in mocked storage (e.g. from TC-02). Converter request counter reset to 0.
steps: Reload the class page (or navigate to another page and back)
expected: The PDF opens straight away (toolbar 'Page 1 / 5'), no 'Preparing exact slides…' indicator and no 'Exact slides ready' toast; converter request counter is 0 (no POST, no job polling); no new file is written to storage

title: Legacy deck (uploaded before the feature, no PDF copy) is converted on first open and switches when done
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Mocked storage pre-seeded with a slide-deck record and legacy.pptx (5 slides) at '<uid>/<classId>/<uuid>.pptx' but NO '.converted.pdf'. Mock converter set to 'succeed'. Counter reset.
steps: Observe viewer and converter log until done
expected: The deck first shows in the PowerPoint viewer ('Slide 1 / 5') with 'Preparing exact slides…'; exactly one conversion is started (1 POST); '<uid>/<classId>/<uuid>.converted.pdf' is saved; viewer switches to 'Page 1 / 5' with 'Exact slides ready'; reopening afterwards makes no further converter requests

title: 'Write on slide' on a PowerPoint deck now shown as PDF adds the current slide as a notebook page
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. deck5.pptx converted (viewer shows PDF). Left panel notes open.
steps: In the Slides viewer go to 'Page 3 / 5'
Left panel → Handwrite tab → add-page menu → 'Write on slide'
Look at the new notebook page
expected: A new notebook page is added whose background is slide 3 of deck5 (matches the PDF page 3 image, not another slide); no 'Open a PDF slide deck on the Slides side first.' message; the page can be written on

title: 'Write on all slides' on a converted PowerPoint deck adds every slide in order (32-slide deck)
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. deck32.pptx (32 numbered slides) uploaded and converted (viewer shows 'Page 1 / 32').
steps: Handwrite tab → add-page menu → 'Write on all slides'
Wait for pages to be added
Count notebook pages and check first, 16th and last page backgrounds
expected: 32 notebook pages are added, in order: page 1 shows slide 1, page 16 shows slide 16, page 32 shows slide 32; no error message; no page errors in the console

title: 'Write on slide' while the PowerPoint deck is still converting explains the exact slides are being prepared
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Mock converter set to 'succeed slowly' (~60 s). deck5.pptx just uploaded; 'Preparing exact slides…' visible.
steps: Handwrite tab → add-page menu → 'Write on slide'
After the switch to PDF, try 'Write on slide' again
expected: While converting, both actions show a message saying the exact slides are still being prepared (NOT 'Open a PDF slide deck on the Slides side first.'); no blank or wrong page is added; after the switch 'Write on slide' adds the current slide as a page

title: Conversion failure keeps the PowerPoint view without an error dialog and retries on next open
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Mock converter set to 'fail' (job returns status 'failed'; also check variant: POST returns HTTP 500). Counter reset. Test deck: deck5.pptx.
steps: Observe viewer, toasts and dialogs; navigate slides
Set mock to 'succeed'; reload the class page and open the deck tab
expected: After the failure the PowerPoint viewer stays ('Slide N / 5', navigation works); no modal/error dialog appears (at most a quiet, non-blocking note); the 'Preparing exact slides…' indicator stops; no '.converted.pdf' is saved; on reopen a new conversion is requested (counter increases by one POST) and on success the viewer switches to the PDF

title: Conversion timeout keeps the PowerPoint view and retries on next open
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Mock converter set to 'time out' (job stays 'processing' forever / no response). Test deck: deck5.pptx.
steps: Wait until the app gives up (observe for up to ~5 minutes; note the time it stops polling)
Observe viewer, dialogs and network polling
Set mock to 'succeed'; reopen the deck
expected: The app stops polling after a bounded time; PowerPoint view stays usable throughout; no error dialog; indicator removed or replaced by a quiet note; no '.converted.pdf' saved; reopening starts a new conversion and switches to the PDF on success

title: Page-count mismatch (deck with a hidden slide) is rejected: PowerPoint view stays
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Test deck: hidden.pptx with 6 slides, slide 4 hidden (viewer shows it as 6 slides). Mock converter set to return a 5-page PDF (wrong page count).
steps: Wait for the mock conversion to finish
Reopen the deck and check converter counter
expected: The PDF copy is not used: the viewer stays on the PowerPoint ('Slide N / 6'), no 'Exact slides ready', no error dialog; no '.converted.pdf' is kept for the deck (or, if written, it is never shown); bookmarks numbering unchanged; reopening the deck tries the conversion again (new POST)

title: Only one conversion per deck: rapid deck-tab switching while converting
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. A PDF deck and deck5.pptx in the class. Mock converter 'succeed slowly' (~30 s). Counter reset.
steps: While converting, click between the PDF deck tab and the deck5 tab 10 times quickly
expected: Exactly one POST /api/convert/office-to-pdf for deck5 (polling requests for one job id only); exactly one '.converted.pdf' upload; viewer ends on the PDF for deck5 when its tab is selected; no page errors

title: Only one conversion per deck: leaving and reopening the class while a conversion is running
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. Legacy deck without a PDF copy (as in TC-05). Mock converter 'succeed slowly' (~30 s). Counter reset.
steps: Open the class and select the legacy deck (conversion starts)
Within 5 s navigate to the dashboard (in-app link) and back to the class, select the deck again
expected: Only one conversion job is running for the deck at any time (at most one POST while the first job is in progress); one '.converted.pdf' saved; viewer switches to PDF; no duplicate toasts beyond one 'Exact slides ready'

title: Deleting a converted deck deletes both the .pptx and its .converted.pdf
preconditions: Signed in (fake session) as a test student, enrolled in a test class; mocked Supabase storage (uploaded paths inspectable); mocked PDF Studio converter with request counter; browser console and network log captured. deck5.pptx converted ('<uuid>.pptx' and '<uuid>.converted.pdf' in storage). steps: Delete deck5 via its deck-tab delete action and confirm
expected: deck5 tab disappears; storage no longer contains '<uid>/<classId>/<uuid>.pptx' nor '<uid>/<classId>/<uuid>.converted.pdf'; deleting the legacy deck succeeds without error (missing copy is tolerated); no page errors

title: Bookmarks, slide counter, AI overview and zoom work after the switch to PDF

title: PDF upload regression: PDF decks behave as before and never call the converter

title: No page errors across the full flow (upload, convert, switch, write on slide, delete)

Upload deck5.pptx and let conversion run; watch console for 'Content Security Policy' violations / securitypolicyviolation events

title: Real converter end-to-end check with curl (download and page count)
preconditions: Test machine with curl and pdfinfo (or python pypdf); network access to pdf-studio-api-xy4g.onrender.com; test decks deck5.pptx and hidden.pptx (no real student data)
steps: curl -F files=@deck5.pptx https://pdf-studio-api-xy4g.onrender.com/api/convert/office-to-pdf → note job id (allow 30–60 s cold start)
Poll curl https://pdf-studio-api-xy4g.onrender.com/api/jobs/<id> until status is done/failed; record total time
Download outputs[0].url (relative) from the same host to deck5.pdf
curl -I -X OPTIONS with Origin: https://lectureloop-preprod.vercel.app and Access-Control-Request-Method: POST to check CORS
Repeat steps 1-4 with hidden.pptx and record its page count
expected: deck5 job reaches 'done'; downloaded file is a valid PDF with exactly 5 pages and slide pictures visible; CORS response allows the pre-prod origin; hidden.pptx result page count is recorded (if it differs from 6 it confirms the mismatch scenario TC-11 guards against)
